verdict.rationale: Pulumi documents a dedicated testing framework with Unit Tests (mocked, no real cloud calls), Property Tests, and Integration Tests using standard language test frameworks, plus 'pulumi preview' to check changes without touching production and Automation API for programmatic test orchestration. This directly satisfies writing/running infra tests without touching production. Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of the testing framework specifically (probes verify preview/up/destroy but not the unit-test mocking flow) and community commentary on test-writing experience.
